head_commit.message:
specs: avoid address collisions in network fixtures

The network fixture helper derived a host address from a row ID.
That value can wrap onto an existing globally unique IP address.
Choose an unused address within the fixture's /24 before registering it,
keeping registration and allocation checks unchanged.

head_commit.message:
specs: initialize release mail double attributes

Generate campaign and request attribute methods before constructing the
verified doubles in the release mail rendering example. ActiveRecord creates
these methods lazily, so running this example before other campaign examples
can reject the real deadline attribute before rendering starts.

Keep the strict doubles and all template assertions independent of test order.

workflow_runs.name: API Specs (topic parallel)
workflow_runs.display_title: Add network availability and correct free IPv4 inventory

head_commit.message:
api: expose authoritative network inventory counts

Count registered allocations available to users using the shared reservation
scope, and report owned allocations without an interface assignment even in
reserved or disabled inventory. These admin-only read-only fields distinguish
available inventory from theoretical capacity and overlapping ownership totals.

The output fields are additive and require no schema migration.

workflow_runs.name: API Specs (topic parallel)
workflow_runs.display_title: api: expose authoritative network inventory counts

head_commit.message:
api: expose authoritative network inventory counts

Count registered allocations available to users using the shared reservation
scope, and report owned allocations without an interface assignment even in
reserved or disabled inventory. These admin-only read-only fields distinguish
available inventory from theoretical capacity and overlapping ownership totals.

The output fields are additive and require no schema migration.

workflow_runs.name: RuboCop
workflow_runs.display_title: api: expose authoritative network inventory counts

head_commit.message:
api: expose authoritative network inventory counts

Count registered allocations available to users using the shared reservation
scope, and report owned allocations without an interface assignment even in
reserved or disabled inventory. These admin-only read-only fields distinguish
available inventory from theoretical capacity and overlapping ownership totals.

The output fields are additive and require no schema migration.

workflow_runs.name: libnodectld Specs
workflow_runs.display_title: Add network availability and correct free IPv4 inventory

head_commit.message:
api: restrict non-admin network and IP lists

Disabled inventory is unavailable for new use and should be omitted from
member lists. Retain owned and assigned addresses within existing
permissions, and preserve direct Show and association access. Apply the
restriction before counts and pagination; admin inventory stays unchanged.
